ideas.markdown:
# Viral ideas: 2026-11-14 (the company)

From the run report: 74 posts, 36 new. **New this run: TikTok gutter and light-installer posts from small pros.** These are the closest match to the company so far. YouTube's bot check hit again, so there was no keyword search, no comments, and no frames for the TikTok posts.

**How to read × usual:** many hits come from brand-new channels or product sellers with tiny medians (11,133×). Use **views per day** and the **like/save rate** as the real signals.

## Patterns this week

1. **Gutters: "what's stuck in there" + water payoff.** The ball blocking the downspout has **3.2M on TikTok** (7.4% engagement, the highest in the run) and 253K on YouTube. Glass Guru's "more hiding up there ⚾" got 42× usual. Clearline's silent **"Full system flush."** got **2.1M from a 687-follower account**. Bailey Home Solutions got 217K in 6 days **with 25 followers**. Small gutter pros are breaking out right now, so the format is doing the work, not the account size.
2. **Christmas lights: the reveal is still the biggest thing in the feed.** HollyGlint's "Then our neighbor did THIS…" is at 34M and **still accelerating** (934K/day rise). The frame: two kids at the door of a house covered in light, with the text overlay as the hook.
3. **Neighbor pressure as the hook.** "The neighbors are already done decorating… What are you doing?" (4.3M). "You NEED this to win your neighbors' Christmas decor" (on-screen text). People watch the competition and the relief.
4. **Small installers win on craft and service details, not spectacle.** "Lights made to fit this house… we take them down and store them" got 2,518 likes on 14K views (**an 18% like rate**). "One small spacing mistake…" is 4 days old at 1.9K/day. "Installation tips for beginners" got 62× usual and 200 saves. Saves mean people want the know-how.
5. **Before → after home fixes still work** (porch steps 12.8M, hole in the wall + landlord skit 6.4M, "what was hiding behind house walls" 1.1M). There's also a winter bridge: "Found the crack letting cold air into my house 🥶" got **665K from an 8-second video**.

## Breakdown

| Post | Format | Hook type | Why it works |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Ball blocking the downspout (TikTok)](https://www.tiktok.com/@big.brother.clean/video/7695451298803567886) · 3.2M, 7.4% eng. | before/after, satisfying | curiosity gap ("what's in there?") | the object reveal is a mini-mystery, then the water rushes out. Highest engagement in the run |
| [Full system flush.](https://www.tiktok.com/@clearline.gutterservices/video/7692259113685896469) · 2.1M, 687 followers | satisfying / ASMR | none spoken; the visual is the hook | no talking, just the hose, muck and a downspout gush. 41 s that feel short |
| [#guttercleaning #fallcleanup](https://www.tiktok.com/@baileyhomesolutions/video/7705932132962602253) · 217K in 6 d, 25 followers | satisfying clean-out | visual | proof a brand-new local account can break out on gutters |
| [The house everyone stops to look at](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ZGaAEzoLcGw) · 34M, still rising | reveal / story | curiosity ("Then our neighbor did THIS…") | text on the first frame + kids' POV + a fully lit house. The emotion is the payoff |

**How to read × usual here:** many of these creators are brand-new channels with a tiny median, so the multipliers are huge (3,520×, 14,136×). Read **views per day** as the real signal.

## Patterns this week

1. **Christmas lights reveal = the biggest thing in the feed right now.** "The house everyone stops to look at this Christmas" has 23M views at 562K/day. Animated pixel lights on a balcony: 12.8M. Christmas decor "1970 vs 2026": 2.2M. Light sellers' window projections: 4.7M and 2.4M. The season has started, and people are watching houses light up.
2. **Before → after on a broken home thing.** "Broken steps to brand-new porch" has 11.6M views at **1.1M/day**, the fastest in the run. "Smart wall repair technique" 2.9M. "Hole in the wall, landlord coming in one hour" 6M. One problem, one fix, a satisfying result.
3. **"Comment WORD to get it"** CTAs ("Comment LUMY…", "Comment Christmas if you need it") on several of the top light videos. The comments drive reach, and the keyword turns viewers into leads.
4. **Winter problem solvers.** The electric snow shovel has 12M views. Homeowners are already thinking about snow and ice.
